_comment: The facts all three installers need, in one place.
install.sh, install.ps1 and install.bat used to each carry their own copy
of the repository URL, the install directory, the build command and the
next-steps lines. Three copies of a URL is three chances to move the
repository and fix two of them — and the one nobody fixes is the Windows
script, because the person who moved it was not on Windows.
Deliberately flat, and deliberately strings and arrays of strings only.
install.sh reads this with sed, because the machine it runs on has just
been told it needs cargo and git and is in no position to also need jq.
Nest anything here and that reader stops working.
next_steps: loopsmith doctor                      # what this machine is, and what that stops you doing
loopsmith loop new --path <dir> --purpose "..."   # scaffold a loop
loopsmith --web                       # or build one in a browser
